table.name: TLGNC_TRUCK_ROUTE
table.description: Contains plan and correction data for truck routes between arbitrary start- and end-points. The standard case is shippingpoint-to-shipto, but in the case of bag-truck deliveries a shipto as starting point is also possible, and for return trips a shippingpoint as the end point can be imagined. This is used also for other transport modes (ship, block train). Outlook: Extend this table for additional start/end point-types if neeeded.

column.name: START_SHIPPINGPOINT_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_shippingpoint. Starting point of this route in case it starts from a shipping point.

column.name: END_SHIPTO_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_shipto. End point of this route in case it ends at a ship-to.

column.name: SAP_TRSP_MODE_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_sap_trsp_mode_bs. Transport mode for this route.

column.name: TIME_CALCULATED_MIN
column.description: Calculated time according to Google-Maps for this route, in minutes. Google calculates the time for a passengar car, not a truck.

column.name: TIME_CORRECTION_FACTOR
column.description: User-defined factor to adjust calculated time for a truck. time_planned_min = time_calculated_min * time_correction_factor.

column.name: DISTANCE_CALCULATED_M
column.description: Calculated distance according to Google-Maps for this route, in meters. Google calculates the time for a passengar car, not a truck.

column.name: DISTANCE_CORRECTION_FACTOR
column.description: User-defined factor to adjust calculated distance for a truck. corrected_distance = distance_calculated_m * distance_correction_factor

column.name: LAST_CALCULATED_DAT
column.description: Date when route was calculated. If null, or too old (configurable in application), re-calculation is needed.
